name: What is the difference between flat, eggshell, and satin paint finishes?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between flat, eggshell, and satin paint finishes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Paint finishes differ in sheen and durability. Flat paint has a non-reflective, matte appearance, excellent for hiding wall imperfections in low-traffic areas like ceilings. Eggshell has a subtle, low sheen resembling an eggshell, offering more durability and easier cleaning than flat, suitable for living rooms and bedrooms. Satin has a noticeable sheen, is highly durable, and very washable, making it ideal for high-traffic areas, kitchens, and bathrooms. Gloss finishes have the highest sheen and durability, often used for trim.
acceptedAnswer.description: Flat paint is matte, hiding imperfections. Eggshell has a subtle sheen, good for general rooms. Satin is durable and washable, ideal for high-traffic areas like kitchens.
